title: Who will succeed Oleksandr Syrskii as Ukraine's top military commander?
background: Oleksandr Syrskii leads Ukraine's armed forces during the war against Russia.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official announcement by Ukraine's presidency or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera. 
  Resolution Condition : Resolve when Ukraine's president formally appoints a successor to Oleksandr Syrskii as the country's top military commander. Temporary or acting appointments do not count unless confirmed as permanent. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The successor's full name.
